description: This file is an extension of the ChannelsStore class specific to macOS platform, implementing asynchronous methods to load, update, and save configuration schemas and values, as well as applying UI-related configuration hints.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema response and UI hints from the GatewayConnection and updates internal state variables.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current configuration snapshot, updates internal state, and applies UI configurations.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Applies UI-related configuration hints from a ConfigSnapshot, updating the AppStateStore's seamColorHex.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration schema node for a specific channel ID from the stored schema.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified path; with special handling for 'channels' section fallback.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates a configuration value at a specified path in the draft configuration and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration asynchronously and reloads the configuration afterward.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the latest configuration from source asynchronously.
